verdict.rationale: Keycloak's own docs say users can set up two-factor authentication from the Account Console, and the admin guide mentions "WebAuthn together with Two-Factor". That is genuine first-party MFA capability, but the evidence never names TOTP authenticator apps, admin-enforced MFA, backup codes, or step-up. Missing for 10: explicit TOTP/OTP authenticator configuration, admin-enforced MFA requirement, backup/recovery codes, step-up authentication enforcement, independent hands-on corroboration.
